resources.string: Guide
How Adhkaar works, and how to make it fit your day.
Times
When the adhkaar open

Morning adhkaar open 10 minutes after Fajr is prayed in congregation (about 6:00 AM) and are best read by 8:30 AM (you can change this). Evening adhkaar open about 30 minutes after Asr is prayed (about 4:45 PM) and are best read before Maghrib; they can still be read until Isha. Everything follows your salah times, so set those first.
Your salah times

The app starts with common local times. Change them to your masjid\'s in Settings › Salah reminders: tap a time to edit it. Your times replace the defaults completely, and you can switch each salah reminder on or off there.
Modes
The mode decides how firmly the app holds you to the morning and evening adhkaar. Before sleep and after salah can use it too, if you choose.
One soft chime and a notification when the adhkaar open. It does not ring again.
Calm and never in the way. Good if you already have the habit.
Easy to swipe away and forget.

The adhkaar open by themselves, even on the lock screen. The alert rings for a minute, and once more 10 minutes later if you haven\'t opened them. After that it stays quiet, but each time you unlock your phone they come back, until you finish or the time ends.
Hard to miss, without stopping you from using your phone.
It interrupts you. Closing it isn\'t the end: it comes back the next time you unlock your phone.

Like Full screen, and other apps are covered until you finish the adhkaar or their time ends (8:30 AM in the morning, or the time you set, Isha in the evening). Calls always work. It is not a reminder that ends early: it lifts when you finish or when the time is over.
The strongest help for building the habit: the phone waits until you have read them.
Strict by design. Use a break if you truly can\'t read now.
Good
Keep in mind
Breaks
Busy when the adhkaar open? Take a break of 10, 20, 30 or 60 minutes. The reminder comes back when the break ends, as long as the adhkaar time is still open.
More
Other reminders
Before sleep, after salah and on waking remind you with a notification and a card. In Settings › Reminders you can make before sleep and after salah firmer: Full screen, or Lockdown for before sleep.
Calendar
The Islamic calendar follows the moon sightings announced in Nigeria when they are available, and calculated dates otherwise. It marks Jumu\'ah, the white days, Ramadan and other special days.
Widgets
Add Adhkaar widgets from your home screen: long-press an empty space, tap Widgets and find Adhkaar. Each comes in three styles.
Keep it working on your phone
Some phones stop apps in the background to save battery. If a reminder doesn\'t come, open Settings › Permissions and allow everything listed, then use Test morning or Test evening to check.
